meta.title: Partner programme for accountants and advisors | ASSETRA Investments
meta.description: Do you have a client considering selling their company? We pay for referrals — a finder's fee of 1–3% of the transaction value. Discreet process, the client stays with you.

hero.label: For accountants, tax advisors and auditors
hero.title: Do you have a client considering selling their company?
hero.subtitle: We pay for referrals. Finder's fee of 1 – 3 % of the transaction value.

turnover.title: Turnover €1 – 10 million
turnover.text: Established companies on the Slovak and Czech market with annual turnover of 1 to 10 million euros.

profitable.title: Profitable for 3+ years
profitable.text: Stable profitability three years in a row — no start-ups, no turnarounds.

succession.title: Owner facing succession
succession.text: Retirement, no successor, or simply fatigue — situations where a sale makes sense.

fee.title: Finder's fee 1 – 3 %
fee.text: A fee based on the transaction value, agreed in writing upfront. The percentage depends on deal size.

payment.title: First payment at SPA signing
payment.text: You don't wait for full settlement — the first part of the fee is paid when the purchase agreement is signed.

discretion.title: Confidentiality and discretion
discretion.text: NDA from the first contact. No listings, no information leaking to the market or competitors.

client.title: The client stays with you
client.text: We don't take over the client's accounting or advisory. Your relationship with the client continues after the transaction — a principle, not a detail.

form.title: Short form
form.text: A few sentences about the company — no client name, no obligations.

call.title: 20-minute call
call.text: We verify the basic parameters and agree on cooperation terms.

nda.title: NDA
nda.text: We sign a confidentiality agreement — only then do we exchange client details.

offer.title: Indicative offer within 14 days
offer.text: The client receives a non-binding indicative offer within two weeks of providing the materials.

form.heading: Referral
form.title: Refer a company — discreetly
form.description: In the first step we don't need the client's or the company's name. A few sentences about the situation are enough. We will get back to you within 24 hours on business days.
form.about: Briefly about the company (without identifying the client) *
form.aboutPlaceholder: E.g. industry, approximate turnover, region, reason for sale…
form.note: Sending is non-binding. The client's identity is discussed only after signing an NDA.

consent: I consent to the processing of my personal data for the purpose of communication regarding partner cooperation, in line with the privacy policy.

success.title: Thank you
success.text: We have received your referral. We will get back to you within 24 hours on business days to arrange a short call.
